plugins.name: poiesis-frontier
plugins.description: New concepts and the experiments that could prove them wrong, from what insight has tested, checked against its challenge stamps: first principles, lateral thinking, systems, complexity, philosophy of concepts, design spaces, estrangement, recombination, speculative design and research, study design for a small group.
